# date: Oct 30, 2026

  description = ''

    My NixOS config based on _nixos-dendritic_ and _nixy_.
  '';

  inputs = {
    # Hardware
    nixos-hardware.url = "github:NixOS/nixos-hardware/master";

    # Nixpkgs
    nixpkgs.url = "github:nixos/nixpkgs/nixos-unstable";

    NixOS-WSL = {
      url = "github:nix-community/NixOS-WSL";
      inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs";
    };

    # Home Manager
    home-manager = {
      url = "github:nix-community/home-manager";
      inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs";
    };

    # Dendritic
    flake-parts = {
      url = "github:hercules-ci/flake-parts";
      inputs.nixpkgs-lib.follows = "nixpkgs";
    };
    import-tree.url = "github:vic/import-tree";

    # Nix User Repository
    nur = {
      url = "github:nix-community/nur";
      inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs";
    };

    # KDE
    plasma-manager = {
      url = "github:nix-community/plasma-manager";
      inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs";
      inputs.home-manager.follows = "home-manager";
    };

    # Secret management
    sops-nix = {
      url = "github:Mic92/sops-nix";
      inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs";
    };

    # Neovim
    nixvim = {
      url = "github:nix-community/nixvim";
    };

    # Rust toolchain overlay
    rust-overlay = {
      url = "github:oxalica/rust-overlay";
      inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs";
    };
  };

  outputs = inputs: inputs.flake-parts.lib.mkFlake { inherit inputs; } (inputs.import-tree ./modules);
}

        enable = true;

        settings = {
          user = {
            name = config.user.username;
            inherit (config.user) email;
          };
          init.defaultBranch = "main";
        };
      };
      lazygit.enable = true;
    };

    home.packages = with pkgs; [
      gh
    ];
  };
}

path: ./modules/home/development/zsh.nix
{ config, homeAspects, ... }: {
  flake.modules.homeManager.zsh =
    { pkgs, ... }:
    {
      imports = [ homeAspects.git ];

      home.packages = with pkgs; [
        pfetch-rs
      ];

      programs.zsh = {
        enable = true;
        enableCompletion = true;
        autosuggestion.enable = true;
        syntaxHighlighting.enable = true;

        oh-my-zsh = {
          enable = true;
          plugins = [
            "git"
            "direnv"
          ];
          theme = "af-magic";
        };

        shellAliases = {
          gs = "git status";
          ga = "git add .";
          gc = "git commit -a -m";
          gps = "git push";
          gpl = "git pull";
          gst = "git stash";
          gsp = "git stash; git pull";
          gcheck = "git checkout";
          gcredential = "git config credential.helper store";
          gl = "lazygit";
          ":q" = "exit";
          l = "ls -la";
          ".." = "cd ..";
        };

        initContent = ''

          export GITHUB_TOKEN="$(gh auth token)"
          pfetch
        '';
      };
    };
}

      options.hyprland-manager = {
        wallpaper = lib.mkOption {
          type = lib.types.path;
          default = ../../../wallpapers/arcane-1.png;
        };
      };

      config = {

        home.packages = with pkgs; [
          nautilus
          # walker # https://github.com/abenz1267/walker
          hyprlauncher # rofi, wofi
        ];

        home.pointerCursor = {
          enable = true;
          gtk.enable = true;
          package = pkgs.bibata-cursors;
          name = "Bibata-Modern-Ice";
          size = 16;
        };

        gtk = {
          enable = true;

          theme = {
            package = pkgs.flat-remix-gtk;
            name = "Flat-Remix-GTK-Grey-Darkest";
          };

          iconTheme = {
            package = pkgs.adwaita-icon-theme;
            name = "Adwaita";
          };

          # font = {
          #   name = "MesloLGM Nerd Font";
          #   size = 11;
          # };
        };

        xdg.configFile = { # immutable config for hyprland
          "waybar" = {
            source = ./waybar;
            recursive = true;
            force = true;
          };
          "hypr" = {
            source = ./hypr;
            recursive = true;
            force = true;
          };
        };

        programs.waybar = {
          enable = true;
          systemd.enable = true;
        };

        services = {
          hyprpaper = {
            enable = true;
            settings = {
              preload = [
                (toString config.hyprland-manager.wallpaper)
              ];
              wallpaper = [
                {
                  monitor = "";
                  path = toString config.hyprland-manager.wallpaper;
                }
              ];
              splash = false;
            };
          };
        };

        wayland.windowManager.hyprland = {
          enable = true;
          package = null; # don't install a second version of hyprland
          portalPackage = null; # don't install a second version of hyprland
          systemd.enable = false;
          };
      };
    };
}

path: ./modules/home/desktop/plasma-manager.nix
{
  inputs,
  ...
}:
{
  flake.modules.homeManager.plasma-manager = { lib, config, ... }: {
    imports = [ inputs.plasma-manager.homeModules.plasma-manager ];

    options.plasma-manager = {
      layouts = lib.mkOption {
        type = lib.types.listOf (
          lib.types.submodule {
            options = {
              layout = lib.mkOption { type = lib.types.str; };
              variant = lib.mkOption {
                type = lib.types.nullOr lib.types.str;
                default = null;
              };
            };
          }
        );
        default = [
          { layout = "de"; }
        ];
        description = "Keyboard layouts for plasma-manager";
      };

      override = lib.mkOption {
        type = lib.types.bool;
        default = true;
        description = "Whether plasma-manager should override existing Plasma config on every boot.";
        example = false;
      };

      wallpaper = lib.mkOption {
        type = lib.types.path;
        default = ../../../wallpapers/arcane-1.png;
      };
    };

    config = {
      programs.plasma = {
        enable = true;
        overrideConfig = config.plasma-manager.override;

        session.sessionRestore.restoreOpenApplicationsOnLogin = "startWithEmptySession";

        workspace = {
          lookAndFeel = "org.kde.breezedark.desktop";
          wallpaper = config.plasma-manager.wallpaper;
          cursor = {
            theme = "Bibata-Modern-Ice";
            size = 20;
          };
        };

        panels = [
          {
            location = "bottom";
            widgets = [
              "org.kde.plasma.kickoff"
              "org.kde.plasma.icontasks"
              "org.kde.plasma.marginsseparator"
              "org.kde.plasma.systemtray"
              "org.kde.plasma.digitalclock"
            ];
            hiding = "autohide";
          }
        ];

        kwin = {
          edgeBarrier = 0; # Disables the edge-barriers introduced in plasma 6.1
          cornerBarrier = false;
        };

        kscreenlocker = {
          lockOnResume = true;
          timeout = 0;
          appearance.wallpaper = config.plasma-manager.wallpaper;
        };

        krunner = {
          activateWhenTypingOnDesktop = true;
          historyBehavior = "enableSuggestions";
          position = "center";
          shortcuts.launch = "Alt+Space";
        };

        powerdevil = {
          AC = {
            powerButtonAction = "lockScreen";
            autoSuspend = {
              action = "nothing";
            };
            turnOffDisplay = {
              idleTimeout = 1000;
              idleTimeoutWhenLocked = "immediately";
            };
          };
          battery = {
            powerButtonAction = "lockScreen";
            whenSleepingEnter = "standbyThenHibernate";
          };
          lowBattery = {
            whenLaptopLidClosed = "hibernate";
          };
        };

        shortcuts = {
          ksmserver = {
            "Lock Session" = [
              "Screensaver"
              "Meta+Ctrl+Alt+L"
            ];
          };

          kwin = {
            "Expose" = "Meta+Tab";
            "Window Maximize" = "Meta+F";
            "Window Fullscreen" = "Meta+Shift+F";
            "Window Minimize" = "Meta+M";
            "Switch Window Down" = "Meta+J";
            "Switch Window Left" = "Meta+H";
            "Switch Window Right" = "Meta+L";
            "Switch Window Up" = "Meta+K";
            "Switch to Desktop 1" = "Meta+1";
            "Switch to Desktop 2" = "Meta+2";
            "Switch to Desktop 3" = "Meta+3";
            "Switch to Desktop 4" = "Meta+4";
            "Switch to Desktop 5" = "Meta+5";
            "Switch to Desktop 6" = "Meta+6";
            "Switch to Desktop 7" = "Meta+7";
            "Switch to Desktop 8" = "Meta+8";
            "Switch to Desktop 9" = "Meta+9";
            # "Switch Window to Desktop 1" = "Meta+Shift+1";
            # "Switch Window to Desktop 2" = "Meta+Shift+2";

path: ./modules/home/creative/video/ffmpeg.nix
{
  flake.modules.homeManager.ffmpeg = { pkgs, ... }: {
    home.packages = with pkgs; [
      (
        (ffmpeg-full.override {
          withUnfree = true; # Allow unfree dependencies (for Nvidia features notably)
          withMetal = false; # Use Metal API on Mac. Unfree and requires manual downloading of files
          withMfx = false; # Hardware acceleration via the deprecated intel-media-sdk/libmfx. Use oneVPL instead (enabled by default) from Intel's oneAPI.
          withSmallBuild = false; # Prefer binary size to performance.
          withDebug = false; # Build using debug options
        }).overrideAttrs
          (_: {
            doCheck = false;
          })
      ) # skip checks after build

path: ./modules/flake/flake-parts.nix

  inputs,
  config,
  lib,
  ...
}:
{
  imports = [
    inputs.flake-parts.flakeModules.modules
  ];

  _module.args.homeAspects = lib.mapAttrs (name: module: {
    key = "home#aspects.${name}";
    imports = [ module ];
  }) config.flake.modules.homeManager;

  _module.args.systemAspects = lib.mapAttrs (name: module: {
    key = "system#aspects.${name}";
    imports = [ module ];
  }) config.flake.modules.nixos;
}

path: ./modules/flake/nixos.nix
{
  inputs,
  lib,
  config,
  systemAspects,
  ...
}:
{
  options.configurations.nixos = lib.mkOption {
    type = lib.types.lazyAttrsOf (
      lib.types.submodule {
        options = {
          system = lib.mkOption {
            type = lib.types.singleLineStr;
            readOnly = true;
            default = "x86_64-linux";
          };
          stateVersion = lib.mkOption {
            type = lib.types.singleLineStr;
            readOnly = true;
          };
          allowUnfree = lib.mkOption {
            type = lib.types.bool;
            default = true;
          };
          module = lib.mkOption {
            type = lib.types.deferredModule;
          };
        };
      }
    );
  };

  config.flake = {
    nixosConfigurations = lib.flip lib.mapAttrs config.configurations.nixos (
      name:
      {
        module,
        system,
        allowUnfree,
        stateVersion,
        ...
      }:
      lib.nixosSystem {
        modules = [
          systemAspects.sops

          module

          {
            nixpkgs = {
              hostPlatform = system;
              config.allowUnfree = allowUnfree;
              config.allowBroken = false;
              overlays = [
                inputs.nur.overlays.default
                inputs.rust-overlay.overlays.default
              ];
            };

            nix = {
              nixPath = [ "nixpkgs=${inputs.nixpkgs}" ]; # legacy commands use same nixpkgs as flake
              registry = {
                nixpkgs.flake = inputs.nixpkgs;
              };
              channel.enable = false;
              extraOptions = ''

                warn-dirty = false
              '';
              settings = {
                download-buffer-size = 262144000; # 250 MB (250 * 1024 * 1024)
                experimental-features = [
                  "pipe-operators"
                  "nix-command"
                  "flakes"
                ];
                substituters = [
                  "https://nix-community.cachix.org"
                  "https://cache.nixos-cuda.org"
                ];
                trusted-public-keys = [
                  "nix-community.cachix.org-1:mB9FSh9qf2dCimDSUo8Zy7bkq5CX+/rkCWyvRCYg3Fs="
                  "cache.nixos-cuda.org:74DUi4Ye579gUqzH4ziL9IyiJBlDpMRn9MBN8oNan9M="
                ];
              };
            };

            networking.hostName = name;

            system.stateVersion = stateVersion;
          }

          inputs.home-manager.nixosModules.home-manager

          {
            home-manager = {
              extraSpecialArgs.hostname = name;
              useUserPackages = true;
              useGlobalPkgs = true;
              users.${config.user.username} = {
                imports = [
                  config.flake.modules.homeManager.sops
                  config.configurations.homeManager.${name}.module
                ];
                home.stateVersion = stateVersion;
              };
            };
          }
        ];

        specialArgs = {
          hostname = name;
        };
      }
    );

    checks =
      config.flake.nixosConfigurations
      |> lib.mapAttrsToList (
        name: nixos: {
          ${nixos.config.nixpkgs.hostPlatform.system} = {
            "configurations:nixos:${name}" = nixos.config.system.build.toplevel;
          };
        }
      )
      |> lib.mkMerge;
  };
}

    boot = {
      plymouth.enable = true;

      loader = {
        efi.canTouchEfiVariables = true;
        systemd-boot = {
          consoleMode = "auto";
          configurationLimit = 8;
          editor = false;
          enable = true;
        };
      };

      tmp.cleanOnBoot = true;
      kernelPackages = lib.mkDefault pkgs.linuxPackages; # _latest, _zen, _hardened, _rt, _rt_latest, etc.

      # Silent boot
      kernelParams = [
        "quiet"
        "splash"
        "rd.systemd.show_status=false"
        "rd.udev.log_level=3"
        "udev.log_priority=3"
      ];
      consoleLogLevel = 0;
    };

    # To avoid systemd services hanging on shutdown
    systemd.settings.Manager = {
      DefaultTimeoutStopSec = "10s";
    };
  };
}

path: ./modules/nixos/system/hardware/nvidia.nix
# Nvidia configuration for NixOS with Wayland support
# Import this module only if you have an Nvidia GPU
# adapted from nixy: https://github.com/anotherhadi/nixy/blob/main/modules/system/hardware/nvidia.nix
{
  flake.modules.nixos.nvidia =
    {
      pkgs,
      config,
      ...
    }:
    let
      nvidiaDriverChannel = config.boot.kernelPackages.nvidiaPackages.production;
    in
    {
      services.xserver.videoDrivers = [ "nvidia" ];

      hardware = {
        nvidia = {
          open = true;
          nvidiaSettings = false;
          powerManagement.enable = true;
          # dynamicBoost.enable = true; # only relevant for laptops
          modesetting.enable = true;
          package = nvidiaDriverChannel;
        };

        graphics = {
          enable = true;
          enable32Bit = true;
          extraPackages = [ pkgs.nvidia-vaapi-driver ];
        };
      };

      environment.systemPackages = with pkgs; [
        vulkan-tools
        mesa-demos
        libva-utils
      ];
    };
}
